# rendering projects dynamically using python
```{python}
# importing portfolio object containing all projects
from data import portfolio

# importing tools to render markdown properly
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

# looping through each project in portfolio
for project in portfolio:
    
    # calling render method and displaying formatted output
    display(Markdown(project.render_markdown()))
